question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word.**

The boss __**persists**__ with his loyalists even now.
solution:
The correct answer is **'discontinues'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Persist **means to continue to exist or occur without interruption. (बिना किसी रुकावट के मौजूद रहना या घटित होना।)

 ** •* Example*- ***If the fool would **persist** in his folly he would become wise.*

 
• **Discontinue **means to stop something or stop producing something. (किसी चीज़ को रोकना या किसी चीज़ का उत्पादन बंद करना)

 ** •* Example*- ***He **discontinued** his visits to the psychiatrist.*

 
• So, it is clear that **'Persist'** and** 'Discontinue'** are **opposite** in meaning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Retinue** means to come together again; to join two or more people, groups, etc. (फिर से एक साथ आने के लिए; दो या दो से अधिक लोगों, समूहों आदि में शामिल होना।)
 
• **Continue** means to keep happening or existing without stopping. (बिना रुके घटित या विद्यमान रहना।)
 
• **Formulate** means to prepare and organize a plan or ideas for doing something. (कुछ करने के लिए एक योजना या विचार तैयार करना और व्यवस्थित करना।)

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4.**
